_comment: One source of truth for week 2's rubric. The grader scores from this file, the homework's grading table is copied from it, and you can read it. If a number changes it changes HERE first.

repoReachable.label: Private coursework repo still reachable (same URL as week 1)

commits.label: 3+ commits touching week-02/ 👀 (meaningful messages are a judgement call)
